[ASSISTANT] Assistant suggested several dessert ideas for a dinner party, including lemon lavender panna cotta, raspberry sorbet, vanilla bean crème brûlée, seasonal fruit tart, pistachio kulfi, citrus-herb granita, and Greek yogurt with honey and walnuts.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant provided tips for making a strawberry tart, including using fresh strawberries, limiting sugar, adding citrus, using a flaky crust, and topping with whipped cream or crème fraîche.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant advised against using whole wheat flour for the tart crust due to flavor and texture considerations.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant recommended using all-purpose flour or pastry flour for a tart crust.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant provided tips for making a tart crust, including keeping ingredients cold and not overworking the dough.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant suggested various ways to arrange strawberries on top of the tart, including simple slice pattern, fresh flower pattern, alternating pattern, random scatter, and strawberry crown.
